name: Matangi Rubber
summary: Matangi Rubber, incorporated in 2004, makes tyre flaps, tyre tubes and rubber compounds, mostly through contract manufacturing and job work for tyre makers, from seven plants in Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Revenue grew from ₹90.1 cr in FY24 to ₹129.8 cr in FY26 (a 20% CAGR) and profit rose 11.5% in FY26 to ₹22.3 cr, but operating cash flow was only ₹3.3 cr. The business depends heavily on one customer: JK Tyre & Industries supplied 59.6% of FY26 revenue and the top 10 customers 96%. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 22.0x, slightly above the 20.5x median of the listed peers named in the RHP, and 45% of the fresh issue goes to repaying loans.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹90.11 cr (FY24) to ₹129.76 cr (FY26), a CAGR of 20.0%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹90.1 cr, ₹101.3 cr, ₹129.8 cr (FY24–FY26), up 12.4% and 28.1%.

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.85 in FY26 (borrowings ₹108.9 cr vs net worth ₹127.8 cr) and 0.80 at June 2026.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 76% (₹61.9 cr to ₹108.9 cr) while revenue rose 44% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹40.2 cr, ₹85.2 cr, ₹127.8 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹3.30 cr in FY26, only about 15% of the ₹22.33 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 11.5% in FY26, from ₹20.03 cr to ₹22.33 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin rose from 5.27% (FY24, standalone) to 18.84% (FY25) and was 16.89% in FY26, down about 2 points in the latest year.

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on equity was 20.98% in FY26.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 15.41% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: FY26 PAT margin of 16.89% vs a peer median of 4.44% (CEAT 4.44%, TVS Srichakra 1.94%, Tolins Tyres 10.82%).

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 22.0x (₹492.2 cr market cap ÷ ₹22.33 cr FY26 PAT) is about 7% above the peer median of 20.5x (CEAT 20.5x, TVS Srichakra 49.5x, Tolins Tyres 9.5x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book is about 2.2x (₹492.2 cr ÷ ₹226.9 cr, i.e. FY26 net worth ₹127.75 cr + ₹99.1 cr fresh issue), but peer price to book figures were not found.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue market cap to FY26 sales is about 3.8x, but peer market cap to sales figures were not found.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: The only share issue in the past 12 months was a January 2026 private placement of 11,38,898 shares at ₹180, above the ₹172 upper band.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 60.01% after the issue, down from 81.11%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Related-party transaction totals were not found; the RHP shows ₹13.13 cr of interest-free loans and advances to related parties at June 2026.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: Tax proceedings are pending against promoters (3 cases, ₹0.14 cr) and other directors (13 cases, ₹12.28 cr).

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The offer for sale is ₹26.06 cr, or 20.8% of the ₹125.16 cr issue.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The ₹125.16 cr issue is about 25.4% of the ₹492.2 cr post-issue market cap (2,86,17,281 shares at ₹172).

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: The main seller, Vandana Rubber and Chemicals (13.63 lakh of 15.15 lakh OFS shares), paid ₹26.67 a share, so the upper band is about 6.4x its cost.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹27.5 cr (27.7% of the ₹99.1 cr fresh issue) goes to new rubber recycling and solid tyre plants at Bhind.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹45 cr, or 45.4% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying loans.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes was not found in public sources.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Cases against the company total about ₹6.22 cr (one civil case of ₹4.19 cr and 19 tax cases), about 4.9% of the ₹127.75 cr net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹7.01 cr at June 2026, about 5.2% of the ₹134.1 cr net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top 10 customers were 96.04% of FY26 revenue, and JK Tyre & Industries alone was 59.56%.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: The top 10 suppliers were 73.69% of FY26 purchases, but the largest single supplier's share was not found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated in June 2004, so about 22 years of operating history.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
